name: Get Jira Issue
description: Fetches one Jira issue by key (e.g. ENG-123): summary, status, assignee, type, priority, reporter, description. Use to view/show/read/look up a specific issue.
author: anything-jira

input.hint: Base URL of your Jira Server / Data Center instance.
Jira Data Center Personal Access Token. Sent as a Bearer token. Stored locally in this skill's plugin.json.

issueKey.description: The Jira issue key to fetch, e.g. 'ENG-123'. Required.
